findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "data" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: github_repo, launch_directories · Private data: fda_approvals · Public sink: hackernews_post, substack_post, bluesky_post, mastodon_post, showhn_best_time, showhn_post_outcome.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: github_repo, launch_directories · Private data: fda_approvals · Public sink: hackernews_post, substack_post, bluesky_post, mastodon_post, showhn_best_time, showhn_post_outcome

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
